facts.fact: The African Union Commission's status list of 02/02/2026 records South Africa as having signed the Convention on 16/02/2023, with no date of ratification or deposit.
facts.system: African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection

facts.fact: As at the list date of 02/02/2026 South Africa had not ratified or deposited the Convention; the list shows 20 of 55 states with a deposit and the Convention in force since 8 June 2023.
